set -euo pipefail
read -ra targets <<< "$TARGETS"
printf 'tree-reader targets: %s\n' "${#targets[@]}"
pkgs="$(printf '%s\n' "${targets[@]}" | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u | grep -vxE 'aprender-(gpu|cuda-edge|compute)' | sed 's/^/-p /' | tr '\n' ' ')"
printf 'packages built: %s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$pkgs" | grep -o -- '-p ' | wc -l)"
EXPR="$(bash scripts/ci_test_tier.sh --filterset "$TARGETS")"
BUILD_FLAGS="$(printf '%s\n' "${targets[@]}" | grep -vE '^aprender-(gpu|cuda-edge|compute):' | tr '\n' ' ' | bash scripts/ci_test_tier.sh --build-flags)"
printf 'build flags: %s\n' "$BUILD_FLAGS"
printf 'nextest filterset (%s clause(s)):\n' "$(printf '%s' "$EXPR" | tr '|' '\n' | wc -l)"
printf '%s\n' "$EXPR" | tr '|' '\n' | sed 's/^ *//; s/ *$//; s/^/  + /'
arc="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/ws-archive"
rustc_vv="$(docker run --rm "$IMAGE" rustc -vV)"
bash scripts/ci/archive_bind_check.sh --toolchain "$rustc_vv" "$arc/bind.json" sha="${GITHUB_SHA}" expr="$EXPR" flags="$BUILD_FLAGS"
printf 'FLOW-010 P1: running shard %s from the prebuilt archive (%s MB)\n' "$SHARD" "$(( $(stat -c %s "$arc/ws.tar.zst") / 1048576 ))"
docker run --rm -e GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 -e GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.directory -e GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=/workspace -e CI -e GITHUB_ACTIONS -e GITHUB_REF -e GITHUB_SHA -e GITHUB_REPOSITORY -e GITHUB_RUN_ID -e GITHUB_EVENT_NAME -e GITHUB_WORKFLOW -v "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}:/workspace" -v "/mnt/nvme-raid0/cargo-ci/registry/${PR_OR_REF}:/usr/local/cargo/registry" -v "/mnt/nvme-raid0/targets/aprender-ci/${PR_OR_REF}/run-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}:/workspace/target" -v "${SCCACHE_HOST_DIR}:/sccache" -w /workspace -e CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/workspace/target -e RUSTC_WRAPPER=/usr/local/cargo/bin/sccache -e SCCACHE_DIR=/sccache -e SCCACHE_CACHE_SIZE=50G -e CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 -e CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 -e RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4 -e NEXTEST_TEST_THREADS=4 -e RUST_TEST_THREADS=4 -e CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 -e CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 -e CARGO_TERM_COLOR=never -e EXPR="$EXPR" -e SHARD "$IMAGE" bash -c 'set -euo pipefail
cargo nextest run --profile ci --archive-file /workspace/ws-archive/ws.tar.zst --workspace-remap /workspace --extract-to /workspace --extract-overwrite -E "$EXPR" --partition "hash:${SHARD}/3"'
